You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From bd9789734b0654f3719615a6239b4779b4ca36f1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: tomas-muller <muller@unitime.org>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2018 13:41:15 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] Event Management: Create Course-related Event Bugfix

- fixed a Null exception when creating a course-related event
- this fixed a problem introduced in commit f6e9e9d (CourseRelatedEvent.getSession() throws a null because the event is not fully created yet)
---
 JavaSource/org/unitime/timetable/model/CourseEvent.java | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/JavaSource/org/unitime/timetable/model/CourseEvent.java b/JavaSource/org/unitime/timetable/model/CourseEvent.java
index 37ae9e2e4..87c8fe676 100644
--- a/JavaSource/org/unitime/timetable/model/CourseEvent.java
+++ b/JavaSource/org/unitime/timetable/model/CourseEvent.java
@@ -83,6 +83,7 @@ public class CourseEvent extends BaseCourseEvent {
 	}
 	
 	public Session getSession() {
+		if (getRelatedCourses() == null) return null;
 		for (RelatedCourseInfo rc: getRelatedCourses())
 			return rc.getCourse().getInstructionalOffering().getSession();
 		return null;
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The root cause of the bug was a NullPointerException occurring in the `getSession()` method of the `CourseEvent` class. This was due to the `getRelatedCourses()` method returning null when an event was not fully created, specifically after a previous commit (f6e9e9d) which did not account for the scenario where related courses might not be initialized before the session was accessed. The patch added a null check for `getRelatedCourses()` to prevent the method from attempting to dereference a null value, thus fixing the issue.

Root cause:
The root cause of the bug was a NullPointerException occurring in the `getSession()` method of the `CourseEvent` class. This was due to the `getRelatedCourses()` method returning null when an event was not fully created, specifically after a previous commit (f6e9e9d) which did not account for the scenario where related courses might not be initialized before the session was accessed. The patch added a null check for `getRelatedCourses()` to prevent the method from attempting to dereference a null value, thus fixing the issue.
